quote: Experiments on two text generation tasks, including positive-sentiment and detoxified text continuation, and debiased text summarization, demonstrate the advantages of our method in aligning LLMs to generated less biased outputs.
We evaluate our proposed Causality-Aware Alignment (CAA) on two text generation tasks, text continuation and text summarization...

Experiments on two text generation tasks, including positive-sentiment and detoxified text continuation, and debiased text summarization, demonstrate the advantages of our method in aligning LLMs to generated less biased outputs.

In addition, we follow Ramamurthy et al. (2023) and Wu et al. (2023) to measure fluency with perplexity for text continuation and lexical and semantic performance with ROUGE-L and BERTScore-Precision for text summarization. Commonly adopted diversity metrics of Distinct are also reported.
